messages.subject: siteCovs contain characters warning
parts:
Hi all,

I've recently started in unmarked and got the following warning message regarding my site covariates. The site covariates are different habitat types (e.g. GRASS, MONT) and bait (YES/NO). 

Warning message:
siteCovs contains characters. Converting them to factors. 

I know it's just a warning message but just want to make sure it is not a problem before I proceed. The summary I ran on my Frame Object looks fine. 

Thank you for your help,
Emma

messages.author: 02d195331194f5bd
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] siteCovs contain characters warning
parts:
It's not a problem. It's just telling you that it's converting your data from one data type (character, or letters) to another (factor, which is when the computer represents each category with a number. So every entry for "GRASS" becomes a 1 and every entry for "MONT" becomes a 2.). This is a necessary step before fitting a model. 

Here's more on data types in R: https://www.tutorialspoint.com/r/r_data_types.htm#:~:text=green%22%20%22yellow%22-,Factors,or%20character%20or%20Boolean%20etc. 

Philip Shirk
